definitions.delta: S2-S1, h2-h1 and u2-u1 according to the named variable; delta(u^T S u)=u2^T S2 u2-u1^T S1 u1
definitions.S_embedding: COMMON_SPEC admits S00=h0,S0i=Si0=-h1_i/2,Sij=h2_ij symmetric tracefree for i,j=1,2,3. Distinct pair labels are 1,2; h1 is the dipole, not the pair label.
definitions.norms: Positive Euclidean vector norm squared=sum_i v_i^2; matrix Frobenius norm squared=sum_ij M_ij^2. Metric g=diag(-1,1,1,1) from COMMON_SPEC; its Frobenius norm uses the positive sum of squares.
definitions.chart: d in R^3, u(d)=(positive sqrt(1+sum d_i^2),d); Du is the actual real Frechet Jacobian. Rapidity bound ||d||<=sinh(R), R real. No added R>=0 assumption; whenever the bound holds it implies R>=0. The d=0 repeated eigenvalue case is included.

assumptions: All scalar/vector/matrix entries real; pair labels j=1,2 refer to one fixed orthonormal observer frame.
C01: S_j uses the COMMON_SPEC optical coefficient embedding; h2_j symmetric tracefree. All Frobenius/vector norms are positive Euclidean component norms.
C02: S_1,S_2 are symmetric covariant real 4x4 matrices; u_1,u_2 are future g-unit real vectors. The bilinear identity is checked universally and does not assume its conclusion.
C03: d in R^3, R real, ||d|| <= sinh R for the bound. The positive square root is used and d=0 is included. R>=0 must be derived when needed from the bound.

units.positive_vector_and_matrix_norms: Euclidean sum of squares; not Lorentz norm
